lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke flies through space, which looks suspiciously like a video game.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This is... actually kind of fun!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: It reminds me of those games I used to play to avoid thinking about shopping.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke dodges asteroids and shoots space debris.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm being heroic! I'm saving the Professor!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the distance, Luke sees a structure.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That must be it! The enemy base where they're holding Professor Layton!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke approaches the structure and lands.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Alright, time to rescue the Professor!
